data.one_liner: A vertical fullscreen scroll implementation that snaps in place, similar to TikTok.
data.what_it_does: Provides a specialized vertical scrollable widget that snaps pages into place with customizable thresholds, swipe velocities, and animation durations. It includes a controller to listen to scroll events and direction changes.
use_when: Building a TikTok-style short video feed or fullscreen vertical card interface
Needing precise snapping behavior for full-height pages
avoid_when: Building standard scrolling lists or multi-directional grids
Needing complex nested scroll views with custom physics outside of full-page snapping
strengths: Easy setup for vertical snap scrolling
Provides velocity and position thresholds for customization
Includes a controller for tracking scroll actions and events
weaknesses: Limited to vertical fullscreen scrolling use cases
Fewer layout options compared to standard PageView or CustomScrollView
